classification.question_topic: Asking if others have visited a recurring 'mansion' realm as a child and what it was like

position.relative_to: isolated structure in an in-between realm; reached by a single road from the horizon to the front entryway

qualities.raw_description: colors extremely muted, almost nonexistant; no sun, moon, or stars—sky is just black; faint horizon line glow with 1 spot of 'lightness' that could be a sun but 'never moves'; mansion is 'only thing there'; 'very old-worldish' and 'MUCH bigger'; made with 'larger stones then brick' (greyish—maybe marble, maybe granite); 1 road winds from over the horizon to the front entryway; outside: 'You never see anyone'

locations.location_name: Outside / In-between realm around the mansion

position.relative_to: surrounding area outside the mansion; includes horizon and the road leading to the mansion

qualities.raw_description: black sky; faint horizon glow; 1 unmoving spot of lightness on horizon; 'mansion is the only thing there'; outside: 'You never see anyone'

position.relative_to: at the end of the single road; in front of the mansion entrance

qualities.raw_description: line of traffic of people coming in every sort of vehicle or animal transportation to get dropped off in front of the mansion to enter; arrivals come 'for the grande Ball & Banquet'

position.relative_to: inside the mansion; reached by adults walking in; children approach the banquet doors/threshold

qualities.raw_description: ballroom/banquet hall is 'quite beautiful'; 'all golden lights' and 'filled with the warm scents of food, champagne, live music (stringed and wind instruments) and conversations'

position.relative_to: inside the mansion beyond the ballroom area; includes many rooms, hallways, and changing wings/corridors

qualities.raw_description: exploration area for children; 'You never know what you'll find in any room or down any hallway'; mansion 'changes after a while'—'moving rooms around and growing random new wings or corridors'; 'each room was decorated differently, and had different objects inside it'

locations.location_name: Portal room(s) (rooms that shift and open to other realms)

position.relative_to: specific rooms within the mansion interior; a chosen room becomes an exit to another realm after waiting

qualities.raw_description: if you liked a room and closed the door and WAITED, there would be a 'shift'—change in air pressure felt in ears/head, or colors get brighter, or air becomes sweeter, or gravity slightly lighter; after shift, opening the door exits to 'THE ACTUAL WORLD/REALM that room existed in, beyond the Mansion'; on return, door closes by itself and 'POOF'—shift happens again; 'strange sort of exhale feeling' as if the room sighs in relief

locations.location_name: Other realms accessed via portal rooms

position.relative_to: beyond a portal room door after the shift

qualities.raw_description: children 'explore the new realm' until an 'overwhelming feeling' they need to return; return guided by push/pull in heart/chest; described as exploring the 'UNIVERSE?' with unclear boundaries

connections.qualities: 1 road that winds all the way from over the horizon to the front entryway of the building
front entryway into the mansion; arrivals are dropped off to enter
adults walk into the ballroom/banquet hall; children approach banquet doors/threshold
choose a room; close the door and wait for a tactile 'shift' before opening again
after waiting, opening the door exits to the 'actual world/realm' beyond the mansion

return triggered by overwhelming need/pressure-warning in chest; return path guided like a homing beacon via push/pull in heart/chest; 'without being seen by others' (like being invisible going to/from a room)
once everyone is back in, the door closes by itself; 'POOF' shift back; 'exhale feeling' as if the room sighs in relief

boundaries.description: black sky with fine horizon line; faint glow and 1 spot of 'lightness' on the horizon; road comes from over the horizon; mansion described as the only thing there

banquet hall threshold/doors function as a one-way boundary: children sense something wrong and back away before stepping over; doors close; 'Noone who goes in EVER comes out'; doors open only for newcomers and for rare kids who genuinely wish to enter

interactions.description: from inside the mansion, looking out windows shows a line of traffic of people arriving in vehicles or animal transportation to be dropped off at the mansion

entities_involved.description: people arriving in every sort of vehicle or animal transportation

interactions.description: arriving adults/parents talk to each other excitedly; upon walking up to the mansion, they suddenly become 'deaf, dumb & blind' to the children with them; children try to voice concerns and discover they can get no interaction from grown-ups

entities_involved.description: parents/adults arriving for the Ball & Banquet; become unresponsive to accompanying children
children accompanying adults; attempt to communicate; react with concern

interactions.description: children approach banquet doors and sense it is a trap; they back away in panic before stepping over the threshold; described as hyperventilating, sweating profusely, crying, shaking uncontrollably; takes 20–30 minutes to calm down; when they respond this way, the doors close

entities_involved.description: children who recognize the trap and avoid entering

interactions.description: adults walk into the ballroom/banquet hall; no one who goes in ever comes out; doors open only for newcomers or for rare kids who genuinely wish to join

entities_involved.description: adults entering the banquet; never seen exiting

interactions.description: children explore the mansion; rooms/hallways are unpredictable; mansion rearranges rooms and grows new wings/corridors; each room decorated differently with different objects

entities_involved.description: groups of children exploring; staying in groups protected kids when doors would close in presence of others who know what it is

interactions.description: children close a room door and wait; a subtle tactile shift occurs (air pressure in ears/head, brighter colors, sweeter air, slightly lighter gravity); opening the door after the shift exits into a different realm; returning is prompted by pressure/warning in chest; they find their way back like a homing beacon; on return, door closes by itself and a 'POOF' shift happens with an 'exhale feeling'

entities_involved.description: children traveling together; described as being 'invisible' going to or from a room

extraction.extraction_notes: Image appears to be a reference-style picture of a dark/old-world mansion exterior rather than a hand-drawn map; no explicit floorplan/spatial diagram to extract. The narrative spans many visits from childhood through teenage years; specific visited realms beyond portal rooms are not individually described, so they are captured as a single abstract location.
